search_limitations: Direct opens of many gov.cy pages returned 403 in the research client; their official search results and excerpts were inspected instead.

No documented API or registration route was identified in the bounded search; this does not establish that none exists.
The exact query strings for the wider source sweep were not preserved; supplemental administrative-law queries are recorded in source-list.md.
